violations.why: The ISR can update v_pylon between the check at line 52 and the reset at line 53, so the write acts on a stale decision.
After the task resets v_pylon to 0, the ISR can overwrite it before line 30 reads it, so the task copies a value it did not expect.
The ISR can change v_pylon between the read at line 52 and the read at line 30, so the two reads can see different values.
The ISR can overwrite the value written at line 63 before line 52 reads it, for example during init().
